title: The Check Function
objective: Write a function that returns ok when a tool is found and missing when it isn't, and use it on two names.
hint: Define Test-Tool with a param block taking [string]$Name. Inside, $found = Get-Command -Name $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue. Then if ($found) returns ok, and else returns missing. Then two Write-Output lines using $(Test-Tool -Name 'cmd') and $(Test-Tool -Name 'collection-missing-tool').
